files.observed_surface: Notes workspace: notebook sidebar, page list, editor on Launch checklist

observations.hierarchy: 'Launch checklist' leads the editor and Save is the sole quiet 40px header button; 'Project Atlas' in the list column renders at the same cap height (17px glyphs, ~24px) as the page title, so two titles compete.
observations.typography: Space throughout; body 15/1.5, content headings step clearly below the title; meta 13px muted; only slip is the equal-size notebook and page titles.
observations.density_layout: Three columns align to one header rule and list rows are evenly spaced; canvas text starts 25px right of the title edge (x564 vs 538), the gap after 'Project Atlas' in the sidebar is larger than the other rows, and the Comments box is cut at the fold.
observations.color: Orange only marks selections (notebook rail, section tab underline, page row rail, Type tool) and focus; one green 'Saved to server' paired with text; meta timestamp muted; Delete in danger text.
observations.visible_affordances: 40px bordered Search and + button, selected page row and Type tool unambiguous, disabled 'Outdent page' visibly distinct from enabled 'Indent page', Delete set apart on the right.
observations.coherence: Recovery disclosure uses the native filled triangle, the Comments area opens as a rounded bordered box while the rest is flat, and Light avatar 'O' has no visible chip: pixels at and around it equal the sidebar (242,239,231) because .avatar uses var(--panel-hover) (styles.css:474), so it reads like a stray '0' beside 'owner'.

observations.palette_tokens: Cream/charcoal panels, orange accent, semantic green/red only.
observations.type_geometry: 40px controls and 8px radii hold; the notebook title duplicates title size and canvas text is off the title edge.
observations.shell: 240px sidebar with SVG icon rows and accent rail, account pinned bottom; wordmark sits in a full-width top bar, and the account region has no role or sign-out (Lock lives in the header).
observations.accent_discipline: Orange only on selection states; four simultaneous markers are all legitimate selection.

files.caveat: Populated 4-page fixture; editor scrolls past the fold so Comments and attachments are only partly visible. workspace-desktop-light is a near duplicate.

drift.method: All 12 unique stage-04 images scored blind; opus-round2/sol-round2 opened only afterwards. Stage 03 and 04 are different captures, so deltas are product change unless the cause says correction.

files.cause: product: recovery notice collapsed to one line, single green status, tab outline gone, select in Space (h/d/co each +1, color +1); light coherence held at 7 by the invisible avatar chip.
product: same fixes as light; dark avatar chip visible so coherence reaches 8.
product: select now Space, chevrons replace +/-, editor padding 24->16 tightens the canvas inset (density 7->8, afford 7->8, coherence 7->8, color 8->9).
product: first row moved from y~590 to ~360 after removing repeated notebook title/label and boxing; hierarchy and density 6->8.
product: id-tail avatar replaced and chevrons; held to coherence 7 because the new avatar chip is invisible in light.
product: avatar initial on a visible chip and chevrons (afford/coherence 7->8, color 8->9).

correction, NOT product: stage 03 and 04 differ only by a ~6px vertical shift of the content (13.8% pixels, no visible change). Opus round 2 scored contract-exact type and an unambiguous grid at 8 and density 7 partly on cross-screen and source-contrast grounds; scored blind against the anchors this round it is 9/9/8/9/9/9. Sol round 2 gave 8.7. Treat +1.0 as reviewer drift.
correction, NOT product: same as light; dark held at affordance 8 for filled grey unselected radios (Sol round 2: 8.7).
product: Settings h1 now precedes the nav block (hierarchy 7->8, coherence 7->8); color 8->9 is a correction (no stray hue then or now).

Round-2 source fail is resolved in source; no computed-style measurement here.

states.evidence: No empty, loading or error captures.

responsive.evidence: 04-after-manifest overflow=0 at 390 and 1280 for all 16 captures; navigation reachable; target sizes not measured.

non_blocking: Light avatar: .avatar background var(--panel-hover) (styles.css:474) equals the light sidebar, so 'O' reads like a stray zero; give it a surface that differs from the sidebar in both themes (e.g. the field-border ring or --ky-panel).
Recovery disclosure uses the UA filled triangle beside stroked chevrons on phone Pages; reuse the same chevron (list-style:none + the shared chevron).
Notebook title in the desktop list column renders at page-title size; drop it a step so 'Launch checklist' is the only 24px title.
Phone Settings nav block takes ~205px with three left edges (x16/26/30); align to 16px.
path_to_8: Met. Notes 8.1 with four views at exactly 8.0; any regression in the light avatar, recovery glyph or picker would drop below 8, so keep them in scope of the next pass.
